import pytest
from isort.parse import skip_line

def test_skip_line():
    # Test cases to cover different scenarios in skip_line
    # No quotes and no comments, should not skip
    assert skip_line('print("Hello")', '', 0, ()) == (False, '')
    # No quotes, but line contains import; should skip
    assert skip_line('print(123); import os', '', 0, ()) == (True, '')
    # Triple quotes found, should indicate quote
    assert skip_line('print("""Docstring""")', '', 0, ()) == (True, '"""')
    # In quote, should indicate that it's still in quote
    assert skip_line('foo = "bar";', '"', 0, ()) == (True, '"')
    # Line has import, should skip
    assert skip_line('foo = "bar"; import sys', '', 0, ()) == (True, '')
    # No comment or import, should not skip
    assert skip_line('no comment here', '', 0, ()) == (False, '')
    # Line with comment, should not skip
    assert skip_line('line with # comment', '', 0, ()) == (False, '')
    # Long comment with import, should skip
    assert skip_line('line with long comment; import re', '', 0, ()) == (True, '')
    # Triple quotes detected, should indicate quote
    assert skip_line('"""Another comment"""', '', 0, ()) == (True, '"""')
    # Single quote with comment and semicolon, should skip
    assert skip_line("'single quote'; # comment", '', 0, ()) == (True, "'")
    # Single quote without semicolon, should not skip
    assert skip_line("'single quote' without semicolon", '', 0, ()) == (False, "'")
    # Single quote with escape, should indicate skip in quote
    assert skip_line(r'foo = "bar\"; some = True', '', 0, ()) == (True, '"')

    # Edge cases
    # Escaped quotes
    assert skip_line("print('this is an escaped quote \\'inside\\'')", '', 0, ()) == (False, "'")
    # Mixed quotes
    assert skip_line('print("some string \'avec\' quotes")', '', 0, ()) == (False, '')

    # Test several semicolons and imports mixed with comments
    assert skip_line('import os; print("hello"); # here is a comment', '', 0, ()) == (True, '')

    # Just comment, should not skip
    assert skip_line('# Full comment line', '', 0, ()) == (False, '')

    # Single line comment mixed with quotes
    assert skip_line("'should not skip' # comment here", '', 0, ()) == (True, "'")

    # Empty line, should not skip
    assert skip_line('', '', 0, ()) == (False, '')
